purpose: Convert verified failures into reproducible, minimally-scoped repair work with evidence, tests, independent review and Owner Gate before deploy.

severity.P1: Major shopper journey or commerce truth failure with high impact
severity.P2: Functional defect with bounded impact or workaround
severity.P3: Minor visual/quality defect without material commerce impact

rules: Never patch from symptom only; reproduce or record BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_EVIDENCE.
Prefer the smallest reversible patch that fixes the verified root cause.
A passing local/unit test is not production proof.
Independent review must not be the same actor that authored the patch candidate.
No Production deploy, migration, payment change, supplier action or external publish without Owner Gate.
Every incident keeps correlation lineage back to the failed run/action.
Every resolved or rolled-back incident writes a learning record and regression guard.

auto_route.behavior: Create READY incident run only. Do not auto-patch, deploy, or send externally.
